title: Second Book of the Lash
summary: A second book that builds on the first strokes and teaches qi to ride the whole length of the lash.

title: Wraps and Pulls for the Working Whip
summary: A working manual on wrapping limbs and weapons with the thong and pulling them with qi behind the arm.

title: A Treatise on the Rolling Cast
summary: A treatise on casting in continuous rolling loops so one stroke flows into the next without a pause.

title: The Cracker and the Cut
summary: A manual pairing the loud crack that frightens with the clean cut that wounds for students at Warrior standing.

title: Whip Reach and Recoil Studies
summary: Studies of how far qi can stretch a strike and how fast the thong must come home to guard.

title: Handbook of the Binding Thong
summary: A handbook centred on binding hands and weapons so that a foe is held while the whip hand stays free.

title: Loop Control for the Journeyman
summary: A journeyman's lesson book on shaping then holding and releasing loops of thong under qi pressure.

title: The Drover's Lash Lessons
summary: Lessons drawn from the long lash used to turn and drive beasts then adapted to turning and driving foes.

title: Wrist Rotation Studies for the Plaited Lash
summary: Studies of rotating the wrist to steer the plaited whip through guards that a straight stroke cannot pass.
